title: Choose the site's new visual world
question: Bolder hand: the deal put the Accretion Disk in the lead. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.lineage: black-hole accretion disks and relativistic light
options.thesis: Ten years of work orbiting inward toward one through-line; Naru sits at the bright photon ring.
options.viewport: A tilted glowing disk filling the right side; each career era is a labelled ring, Naru in gold at the horizon, the name and the Naru action on the left.
options.risk: Closest of these to the precious art piece you ruled out, and it needs a shader to look real.

raised.raise: Intensity scale: type size encodes how current and significant each item is, so Naru reads loudest and 2015 quietest.
Stable addresses: every ring and project has its own URL, so a visitor can link straight to an era.

options.label: Build Instructions
options.thesis: Your career as a build manual: numbered steps, a parts inventory, and Naru as the piece clicking in now.
options.viewport: Parts inventory of your stack top left, the name huge, a stacked model of six dated eras with Naru as the new red brick and a dashed arrow to its seat.
options.case: Beats the leader on both: builders see themselves in it, it echoes your games roots, and a numbered sequence is very clear.
options.risk: Must stay generic brick-manual language, never a toy brand's look, and can feel playful for a senior pitch.

options.label: Departures Board
options.thesis: Your experience timeline becomes the departures board: Naru is now boarding, everything else has arrived.
options.viewport: The name as a station sign over a full-width board: year, destination, role and status columns, with flaps cascading in on load.
options.case: Beats the leader on both: the most scannable record of the lot, and it keeps your timeline as the centrepiece.
options.risk: The flap cascade is the whole trick; long prose (about, project write-ups) needs a calmer surface in the same steel and black.

options.label: Risograph Print
options.thesis: The site printed in fluoro spot inks that misregister and bloom a third colour where they overlap.
options.viewport: The name doubled in pink and blue slightly out of register, overlapping ink shapes, and a pink 'Now printing: Naru' action.
options.case: More recognisable to makers than the leader, but it's a print skin more than a structure, so clarity is only even.
options.risk: Riso portfolios are common among designers, and a paper ground drifts toward the cream look you're leaving.

options.label: Variety Telop
options.thesis: Captions sized to the emotion of what you're saying.
options.viewport: Outlined captions scattered over the frame.
options.case: AI builders don't identify with variety TV, and scattered captions bury the record.

options.label: Teletext Mosaic
options.case: Repeats the Teletext Service you already passed on last hand.
options.risk: A re-run of an eliminated world.
options.kept: Stable page addresses in the URL.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and one-line pitch, two buttons, a row of project cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most engineer portfolios by design.
